rec.name: PDP Multiple Product Videos (Story Bubbles with Popup)
rec.status: Built — launched for client 3rd May (static version + metafield/metaobject version); not yet ported to the generic Sectionfy library section

what.text: A PDP section with a centered heading and a row of round thumbnail 'bubbles', each with a text label below (e.g. 'How to style', 'Material', 'Production'). Clicking a bubble opens a popup (modal) with a main title and a video (or image), followed by several content blocks (Title, Thumbnail, Content 01-03 and more). The section exists in two versions: (1) a static version configured in the theme editor, and (2) a version driven by product metafields and metaobjects, so each product can show its own unique bubbles and content. The metafield version hides itself when a product has no metaobjects.

why.text: Story-style bubbles are a familiar pattern from social media, so shoppers instinctively tap them. They let customers explore usage, material and production details on demand without lengthening the page. Video and image content shows the product in use, reduces uncertainty and communicates product value and brand credibility. Per-product content keeps the information relevant to each item.

how.text: Build a section with 'Item' blocks (one per bubble): button thumbnail image, button label, and a popup with heading plus a video or image. Each item also has multiple content blocks (title, thumbnail, content) shown at 9:16 in the popup. Static version: everything is edited in the theme customizer. Metafield version: create a product metafield that references a list of metaobjects (one metaobject per bubble, with button text, button background, popup heading, media and content blocks). Loop over the referenced metaobjects in Liquid on the product page, since the theme customizer cannot natively bind to them. Hide the section if the product has no metaobjects. Add the section manually to any custom product template (it is pre-set in the Default product template; templates duplicated from Default inherit it). Hide the heading number/icon when the title is empty. Make sure the store grants access to Custom data (product and variant metafields and metaobjects).

items: Alignment (desktop and mobile: left / center / right)
Heading text (rich text), font size (desktop and mobile), color
Modal button settings (spacing, desktop and mobile)
Per-item button text and button background
Heading media: video or image (either one can be used, or none)
Content block thumbnail size on mobile
Optional section title; the icon/number is hidden if empty

dependencies.text: Metafield version requires: a product metafield that references metaobjects, a metaobject definition for each bubble (button text, button background, popup heading, thumbnails, titles, contents), and store permissions for 'Custom data' (products, variants, metaobjects). The section must be added manually to each non-default product template. Static version has no dependencies. No third-party app needed; the 'Sectionfy' name refers to a library of sections.

items: Conversion rate of sessions that opened a popup vs. those that didn't

images.caption: Theme editor: 'Multiple Product Videos' section with 3 Item blocks and a settings panel (background, spacing, alignment, heading, modal button settings). The preview shows the heading 'DIE VERWENDUNG' with three round bubbles labeled 'Button'.
Final PDP result: heading 'SPANNENDE EINBLICKE' with three round image bubbles labeled HOW TO STYLE, MATERIAL, PRODUKTION, and the section's Item blocks in the editor sidebar.
